title: Zesty Fermented Australian Lamb Pilaf
description: A flavorful Australian dish featuring aromatic rice, tender lamb, and a tangy fermented flavor.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of lardons-render in a large, heavy-based frying pan over medium heat.
Add the lamb shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Set aside.
Soak the Basmati rice in a large bowl of water for 30 minutes, then drain and set aside.
In a blender or food processor, combine red wine vinegar, garam masala, ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Blend until smooth, then pour the mixture into a large wooden-board with a non-reactive surface.
Add the cooked lamb shoulder to the board, then top with the soaked Basmati rice.
Mix well to combine, then cover the board with plastic wrap and set in a cool, dark place for 24 hours.
After 24 hours, discard the plastic wrap and fluff the pilaf with a fork to separate the grains.
Heat the lardons-render in the frying pan over low heat, then stir in the fermented pilaf mixture.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the pilaf is heated through and fragrant, about 10 minutes.
Stir in chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
